opportunities.title: Research and Travel Grants - Research Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards not made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree; retrospective applications not considered. Early career researchers welcomed. Named awards include Marion Wilson (southern Britain), Joan Pye (early-career researchers in prehistoric and Roman UK archaeology), Hugh Chapman Memorial (Western Roman Empire or antiquarian matters in London).
opportunities.summary: Annual project grants of £500 to £5,000 to support research into the human past through its material culture or material remains, with no period, geographic or disciplinary restrictions. Covers archaeology, art history, architectural and buildings history, material culture, history of collecting, and intellectual enquiry. Awards made annually with possible renewal up to two further years (max three years total).

opportunities.title: Beatrice de Cardi, Janet Arnold, Tessa & Mortimer Wheeler and William Lambarde Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Two references required for Beatrice de Cardi awards. Not for work contributing to a degree or retrospective applications.
opportunities.summary: Named awards within the Research and Travel Grants programme covering Beatrice de Cardi, Janet Arnold, Tessa and Mortimer Wheeler, and William Lambarde awards, with applications due 7 April annually and references by 14 April.

opportunities.title: William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: No references required for Morris applications. Applications require supporting documents such as photographs, architect/conservation reports or budgets.
opportunities.summary: Church conservation grants with two application rounds each year on 31 March and 31 August. Fund conservation of church buildings and monuments.

opportunities.title: Linda Parry Textile Conservation and Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: No references required. Applications made via the William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants form. Requires supporting documents such as photographs, conservation reports or budgets.
opportunities.summary: Textile conservation and research grants following the William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants application rounds (31 March and 31 August).
